For every touched refs entry the sweep asserts r1_after == r1_before under _cwo_coverage_ezek.CANON_REF (line 37): an entry inside the strict shape before is inside it after; an entry outside it before is REPORTED by row, path, bytes before and bytes after, and is outside it after in the same way, which the changed-only-at-quote-characters assertion already proves for the bytes and which the regex guarantees for the status (CANON_REF admits free text only inside the trailing parenthetical, \(.*\) under re.S, so replacing a U+201C/U+201D pair by single quotes can move no entry into or out of the shape; self-check on the entry's bytes: r1_before False, r1_after False, the string differs at positions 16 and 28 only; synthetic forms inside and outside the shape keep their status under the same substitution). The sweep further PINS the expected outside set: outside_r1_before == outside_r1_after == 1, and the one entry is P08-013 [105].boundary_evidence_refs[1] at exactly the bytes 'oshb:Ezek.36.26 “a new heart” — contrasted, single-witness, with oshb:Ezek.11.19 “one heart” (same witness); both spliced verbatim' (CWO-EZ-01's triage flag; CWO-EZ-11's reported_not_touched entry; per the queue the only witness-prefixed entry outside CANON_REF on the chain head, consistent - inferred - with CWO-EZ-11's outside_strict_shape_after 1 carried through CWO-EZ-13's 25 in-shape entries). Any touched entry whose status changes, any other touched entry outside the shape before, and any count other than 1 and 1 is a problem and the run aborts. The #e6 parenthetical '(outside_r1_after 0)' is AMENDED in words to '(outside_r1_after == outside_r1_before == 1, the one entry reported)': it was written on the #e6 queue's incomplete premise, disclosed in this queue, that a quote-character change keeps an entry in shape, without noting that one class entry was never in it. CWO-EZ-18's text as #e6 wrote it stands unamended and its R1 clause is read as ruled here; corpus_wide_orders is therefore empty. (2) WHAT THE SWEEP DOES WITH THE ENTRY. It converts “a new heart” to 'a new heart' exactly as CWO18-SHORT-1 and CWO18-SCOPE-1 (LABELS converted (11): P08-013 refs[1]) rule; it leaves “one heart” the verbatim_author item it already is (one verse, Ezek.11.19); it changes nothing else in the entry; the entry's shape stays the CWO-EZ-01 triage flag that coverage v3 records (verdict COVERED, residual_count 0). The words 'not touched' may never describe this entry in the CWO-EZ-18 manifest: it IS touched, at two quote characters. The script's own docstring (line 37) is reworded to match. (3) WHY (B) IS REJECTED. (B) would reclass a span #e6 ruled a label (CWO18-SHORT-1; CWO18-SCOPE-1's enumeration) for a reason that has nothing to do with the span's words; it would make the per-span class equality, which #e6 (2) made the gate, fail against #e6's own enumeration unless that enumeration were amended too; it would obtain 'outside_r1_after 0' by narrowing the touched set rather than by any change to the entry, which is proof by narrowing (E-18 as #e4 CWO-EZ-14's why states it: a class is proven by one sweep over the whole corpus, never by row list); and it would send the author a 'drop the quotes' edit the sweep proves lossless. (4) NOT WEAKENED, IN WORDS.
